summary: Created Redux state structure for SMS message scheduling and management. Installed @reduxjs/toolkit and react-redux. Created sms.types.js with MessageStatus enum and JSDoc type definitions, smsSlice.js with createSlice containing addMessage, updateMessageStatus, removeMessage, setLoading, and setError reducers plus selector functions (selectAllMessages, selectMessageById, selectPendingMessages, selectMessagesByStatus), and store/index.js with configureStore. Wired Redux Provider into main.jsx entry point. Build passes cleanly.
